rust_summary: Custom-frame humanoid armour parts, articulated player wings and capes, and staged equipment outline policies.
doc_summary: Host::draw_armor_part and Host::draw_player_back draw equipment on camera-relative world-block frames without applying draw.pose_matrix() again. NativeHumanoidPart, NativeBackLayer and NativeEquipmentDrawOptions select geometry, light, overlay and outline policy. Helpers return false without geometry when the requested equipment is unavailable. Require hooks @API:equipment_draw@ or higher.
